				</itemset>
			</select1>
			<trigger vellum:ref="#form/account_settings/account_already_used" ref="/data/account_settings/account_already_used" appearance="minimal">

<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Close hazard</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/a4021aff" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Close hazard">
					<var>
						<user>
							<username />
							<fullname />
						</user>
						<v_today />
						<v_username />
						<v_open_count />
						<v_status />
					</var>
					<s1>
						<open_count_display />
						<closure_note />
					</s1>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/session" id="commcaresession" />
			<instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var" nodeset="/data/var" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user" nodeset="/data/var/user" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user/username" nodeset="/data/var/user/username" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user/fullname" nodeset="/data/var/user/fullname" calculate="concat(instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_first_name, ' ', instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_last_name)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_today" nodeset="/data/var/v_today" calculate="format-date(today(), '%Y-%m-%d')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_username" nodeset="/data/var/v_username" calculate="instance('commcaresession')/session/context/username" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_open_count" nodeset="/data/var/v_open_count" calculate="count(instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_type = 'action'][@status = 'open'][index/parent = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id])" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_status" nodeset="/data/var/v_status" calculate="'closed'" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1" nodeset="/data/s1" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/open_count_display" nodeset="/data/s1/open_count_display" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/closure_note" nodeset="/data/s1/closure_note" type="xsd:string" vellum:constraint="#form/var/v_open_count = 0" constraint="/data/var/v_open_count = 0" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('s1/closure_note-constraintMsg')" required="true()" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/user/username" ref="/data/var/user/username" value="instance('commcaresession')/session/context/username" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="s1-label">
						<value>Close hazard</value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/open_count_display-label">
						<value>Actions still open: <output value="/data/var/v_open_count" vellum:value="#form/var/v_open_count" /></value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/closure_note-label">
						<value>Closure note</value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/closure_note-constraintMsg">
						<value>Cannot close: <output value="/data/var/v_open_count" vellum:value="#form/var/v_open_count" /> actions still open.</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
				<translation lang="fra">
					<text id="s1-label">
						<value>Close hazard</value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/open_count_display-label">
						<value>Actions still open: <output value="/data/var/v_open_count" vellum:value="#form/var/v_open_count" /></value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/closure_note-label">
						<value>Closure note</value>
					</text>
					<text id="s1/closure_note-constraintMsg">
						<value>Cannot close: <output value="/data/var/v_open_count" vellum:value="#form/var/v_open_count" /> actions still open.</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/var" ref="/data/var">
			<group vellum:ref="#form/var/user" ref="/data/var/user" />
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/s1" ref="/data/s1" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('s1-label')" />
			<trigger vellum:ref="#form/s1/open_count_display" ref="/data/s1/open_count_display" appearance="minimal">
				<label ref="jr:itext('s1/open_count_display-label')" />
			</trigger>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/s1/closure_note" ref="/data/s1/closure_note" appearance="multiline">
				<label ref="jr:itext('s1/closure_note-label')" />
				<alert ref="jr:itext('s1/closure_note-constraintMsg')" />
			</input>
		</group>
	</h:body>
</h:html>
